pageCache.text:
Church School Inspection
Welcome
Haresfield Church of England Primary School provides a secure and creative environment where individuals are valued, nurtured and encouraged to achieve all they can. It is supported by effective partnerships with parents and the community and is underpinned by its Christian ethos. We welcome children from the village and well beyond, parents choose us because we go the ‘extra mile’ with every child so that all pupils, whatever their needs, are supported in their learning. Our Golden Rule:
“Treat others as you would like to be treated.” Matthew 7 v 12 As a Church School , we base our rules on Christian teaching. We take responsibility for our own actions, recognising that when we make mistakes, we can start again. Haresfield School was established as a Church of England school in the 19th century. The school was re-built in 2007 and so we have modern, well-designed facilities. The offices remain in the original building keeping a link with our past. We are very fortunate to have the use of a huge playing field – The Merryfield. We play outside in all weathers amid the beautiful countryside and beneath the Haresfield Beacon. We welcome all families to our school and will be delighted to show you around if you are looking for a school for your child.

Governors
Welcome
chair@haresfield.gloucs.sch.uk
As a teacher who has worked in Primary Education for over twenty years I understand the important role a governor has in shaping the direction of a school in terms of curriculum, policy and the needs of all the pupils. As a teacher who worked in the school and now in teaching teacher training at the university of Gloucestershire, I want to help and support all the excellent work the staff that provide our children with an outstanding environment to learn and explore new things.
My 2 daughters attend Haresfield School and I am passionate about supporting the school and staff in any way that I can to help give all the Haresfield children the best school experience. I have over 15 years’ experience of leading children’s clubs at our local church, across multiple locations and enjoy seeing children chasing their dreams and become all that they can be in life! I also oversee the afterschool club at Haresfield School and love being part of the wider school community. In my spare time I enjoy spending time with my family and playing sport (badly!) I’m really looking forward to my time as a parent governor.
Local Authority Governor
I have volunteered and worked in the public sector for over 20 years; starting life as a Secretary and various admin-related roles, until I retrained several years ago. Since then, I have worked as a Project Manager on projects relating to health, employment, learning conditions and more recently procurement/implementation of new equipment. Having moved from Wiltshire to Hardwicke in July 2019, I was keen to support the the local community and have a passionate belief that a positive and engaging education can change the course of a lifetime.
Ex-officio Foundation Governor
I have been a Churchwarden at St Peter’s from June 20o8 and a Foundation Governor from October 2010. I was born & brought up in London. I worked in post- production in film & television until 1995 and have been a house husband since then. We moved to Gloucestershire in 1997. I served on the governing body of Wynstones Steiner Waldorf School 2000-2006. I am a parent of three children. My wife was a Mathematics in a Gloucester secondary school.
